hints.title: Subarray Difference View
hints.text: Swapping a subarray between two sequences changes the total sum by the sum of differences in that window.

hints.title: Kadane Formulation
hints.text: To maximize the sum of sequence 1, find the maximum contiguous subarray sum in sequence 2 minus sequence 1.

hints.title: Symmetric Evaluation
hints.text: Compute Kadane maximum subarray sum for both difference arrays: nums2[i] - nums1[i] and nums1[i] - nums2[i].

hints.title: Dual Kadane Implementation

variables: n: length of nums1 and nums2
complexity.notes: Single linear pass over each difference array.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Evaluating all possible subarray swap intervals takes O(n^2) time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Tracks running contiguous gain with two scalars.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Recognizes that subarray swap equals contiguous delta maximization solvable by Kadane.
